item.title: Video REC v2.14.0
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Video REC v2.14.0 We are pleased to announce that our new Video REC v2.14.0 has been released for suitable production services. This new version adds Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML, including full login, callback, and per-user auth provider configuration. All users with previous maintained versions can upgrade today. Please contact our support! ## [2.14.0] - 2025-05-23 ### Added - SSO integration via SAML, including login flow, callback handling, and user-level auth provider config ### Changed - Renamed `processingTimeout` server config variable to camelCase for consistency ### Fixed - Increased timeout on server and webapp for service deletion plus suppressed S3 CLI output to prevent buffer errors during bucket cleanup Interactive Powers - Streamline your business communications

item.title: The importance of Video Call Recording for online customer support
item.description: Source: Interactive Powers Why getting video recordings is key for a successful Video Contact Center? Benefits, Implementation Considerations, and Recommendations Currently, many companies are looking for implementing a video contact center as a way to improve the customer experience. However, not all of these companies are fully taking advantage of the potential of this tool. One of the most important features to consider when implementing a video contact center is the ability to record customer interactions on video.
